subject: SpICE kickoff: intelligibility assessment as a service
body:
Team,

Kicking off the SpICE productization. Our open-source SpICE models take speech samples and output intelligibility on a 0-4 scale (typical, mild, moderate, severe, profound). The training base is what makes this defensible: 551,176 disordered-speech samples from 468 speakers, and published generalization without further training - 100% accuracy on TORGO, 0.93 correlation on UASpeech, 0.81 AUC on ALS-TDI PMP.

Product goal: a clinical-partner-facing assessment API with confidence reporting, starting from the released Keras classification model.

Milestones for Mar 9 - Jun 15: serving wrapper plus eval battery reproduced by Apr 17, realistic-speech validation (the unprompted-speech style set) by May 15, retrained pooled-corpus model and launch-review readiness by Jun 12. Privacy review starts now - disordered-speech audio is sensitive data and the SLA is 2-3 weeks.

Ivo owns staffing and the compute reservation.

Goran
